scope: LV3 U02 permission family; five selected original cloze questions, not a whole-unit audit

cases.stem: These windows _____ fresh air to enter the basement.
cases.sentenceEn: These windows allow fresh air to enter the basement.
cases.alternativeSentence: These windows permit fresh air to enter the basement.
cases.rationaleZh: permit + 受詞 + to V 與 allow 相同，windows permit fresh air to enter 文法、原意均成立。

cases.stem: The contest rules _____ copying another team's design.
cases.sentenceEn: The contest rules prohibit copying another team's design.
cases.alternativeSentence: The contest rules ban copying another team's design.
cases.rationaleZh: ban copying 與 prohibit copying 均可表示禁止抄襲；ban 在本單元另列為名詞，不影響這裡可作動詞的語言事實。

cases.stem: We asked for _____ to record the interview.
cases.sentenceEn: We asked for permission to record the interview.
cases.alternativeSentence: We asked for consent to record the interview.
cases.rationaleZh: ask for consent to record an interview 可自然表達請求錄音同意，沒有題前線索排除 consent。

cases.stem: The school cannot share these photos without parental _____.
cases.sentenceEn: The school cannot share these photos without parental consent.
cases.alternativeSentence: The school cannot share these photos without parental permission.
cases.rationaleZh: parental permission 與 parental consent 在分享照片情境均自然，中文「同意」也不能唯一區別。

cases.stem: All members gave their _____ to the revised schedule.
cases.sentenceEn: All members gave their agreement to the revised schedule.
cases.alternativeSentence: All members gave their consent to the revised schedule.
cases.rationaleZh: gave their consent to the revised schedule 是合理同意表達；目標 agreement 仍保留，不把同義詞合併成同一教材身分。
